Air India's baggage allowance for flights from Bengaluru (BLR) to London (LON) will depend on the fare type (class of travel) and ticket-specific conditions. You can refer to the "baggage allowance printed on the tickets" for the initial guidance. However, if the printed allowance on the ticket does not match the applicable allowance, the applicable baggage allowance rates will be enforced. 

Make sure to verify the exact allowance details via the Air India app, website, or your booking confirmation for the specific flight class you are flying (e.g., Economy, Business, First). If further clarification is needed, it’s recommended to consult Air India customer support.
